verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a public Registrar API for searching, checking, registering and managing domains. A probe confirms a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is published, and a community user mentions driving Cloudflare via API keys, though in a DNS context. Missing for 10: endpoint-level detail in the pack on which operations (transfers, WHOIS edits, auto-renew) are API-exposed versus dashboard-only, and independent hands-on corroboration of the Registrar API specifically.
